contexts.text: Thus there arose the suspicion that he had perpetrated something deadly during the bodily life. SE 1260.
That such a deadly and suffocative persuasion should no longer come forth. Signified.
Before... He turn it into a deadly shade ().
The stench (of a certain woman) was as it were deadly.
The falsity which (the Nephilim) infused was attended with a direful Persuasive, and was deadly...
Gangrenous sores... which bring death to the body.
A scorpion = a deadly Persuasive... For when a scorpion stings a man, it induces a stupor upon the limbs, and, if it is not cured, death.
This state is the death of your joys.
Like one who... is struck (by a scorpion) with a deadly wound.
That they should not be hurt if they drank a deadly thing () = that the wickedness of the Hells should not infect them.
